business_models.name: One-time purchase
business_models.trade_off: Simple to explain; revenue stops unless new buyers keep coming.

business_models.name: Subscription
business_models.trade_off: Recurring revenue if people keep using it; churn decides everything.

business_models.name: Free tier + paid upgrade
business_models.trade_off: Lowers the barrier; most free users never pay, so test conversion first.

business_models.name: Pay per use
business_models.trade_off: Fits occasional use; revenue is lumpy.

business_models.name: Business licence (per site)
business_models.trade_off: Fewer, larger customers; a longer sales cycle.
